description: This is a React component for the front-end of a To-Do List application, implementing task display, addition, filtering, toggling completion, and deletion, with local storage persistence.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Defines metadata for the page, including title and description.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Main React component rendering the to-do list interface, managing state and user interactions.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new task to the list, with validation.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task from the list.

methods.name: onInputKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard input, specifically adding a task on Enter key.
